name: Theodoric
biography: Ostrogothic King of Italy (493-526) who, though an Arian, preserved Roman civil administration, law, and the Senate, and was on good terms with the Catholic Church until his last years, when suspicion of a plot led him to imprison and execute his minister Boethius.
